digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, skill discipline
propositions: A 344-bug corpus analysis identified recurring escape channels across observability, gates, migrations, and validation discipline that require systematic remediation.

Bug provenance must be observable at creation and trend-queryable without new required user input, and deterministic pre-commit gates must prevent raw git writes, unread config fields, unbounded wall-clock asserts, unchecked acceptance criteria, code-comment rot, and unreviewed oversized bug fixes.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, vote normalizer) must be migrated from shell to Python per strangler-fig policy.

Canary and automation bug filing must follow a hardened deduplication pattern with a documented bug-creation contract, and transport must be typed end-to-end with declared field asymmetries pinned by property tests.

Skill discipline standards (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, test-design) must encode approved upgrades: ticket writebacks, two-axis invariant sweeps, surface census, config-effect contrast, contention triggers, and gate-finding oracles.
Pre-330c completion attestations must be grandfathered by recomputing signed hash byte-exactly against legacy non-normalized material to restore certifiability and enable completion-verifier re-run.
